issue.title: test_tool_runs_harness_passes_every_hermetic_case intermittently loses concurrent stage evidence and safety-net diagnostics
issue.description: Investigate incomplete ToolRun evidence in the hermetic smoke harness under the parallel slow lane. Preserve exit semantics, unique stage identity, and missing-finish safety-net assertions; do not increase timeouts or weaken the expected evidence without root-cause proof. Related but not proven duplicate: sase-1k8 verdict classification and sase-1jl parent attribution flakes.

task_type_fields.evidence: Independent landing discovery while following sase-1kx.5.3.2 note #2. Full CI 38669105903 at 2465bc7a1814aff6dcc5232e5218b9a424f843d3 failed perf-floors job 116210413655 on 2026-10-15T02:21:45Z, Python 3.12, under the parallel slow lane: 1 failed/14 passed/5 skipped. dod-10-concurrent returned four correct exit codes [3,3,3,3] but only six distinct stage IDs (expected twelve); dod-7-triage-safety-net returned the expected exit 7 but diagnostics were empty. Full CI 38653006628 at the identical SHA passed perf-floors job 116188041309 earlier. These are differing outcomes on an unchanged tree, with the passing witness preceding the observed failure; no isolated rerun or root cause is claimed. Source: tools/_smoke_tool_runs_cases_evidence.py::concurrency and tools/_smoke_tool_runs_cases_triage.py. The repair commit only changes visual fixtures and release watcher parsing, not this harness or ToolRun recording. URLs: https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/38669105903 and https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/38653006628 .
